start.text: The shift is over. The access that did not fit the job was mostly one folder: Salaries.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. The lesson is the same every time: give each person only the access the job needs, and close it when they leave.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Some of the new cards [b][color=green]Expose[/color][/b] the threat: point at the word to read it. Mark the threat first, then hit it.
B.name: Carla

C.text: So I buy the upgrade my clues point at, and I mark the threat before I strike.
C.name: Joshua

D.text: Exactly. Use your Security Points, and read what your clues recommended.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Understood. A smaller door now means less to defend later.
E.name: Joshua
